selected_text: Hypothesis: adding a case-insensitive proxy-credential name check to the shared cross-origin predicate removes all observed leaks without a second code path. Prerequisites: a disposable patched copy and the existing two-server fixture. Bounded test: patch the predicate, rerun the casing and array matrix for 302 and 307, then run a benign regression with a direct request, a relative same-origin redirect, a cross-origin redirect carrying mixed-case credentials plus a proxy challenge and duplicate marker header, and the fetch-style API. Expected supporting result: zero cross-origin credential deliveries, same-origin and direct requests preserved, challenge and marker headers preserved. Falsifier: any leak remains or any benign header is lost. Cleanup: keep the patch in the disposable copy and export only the diff.
